svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron" agent="parameter-golf" version="21.0.0"> <diagram id="pipeline-model-soup" name="ModelSoup"> <mxGraphModel dx="900" dy="500" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="900" pageHeight="420" background="#ffffff" math="1" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" />
<mxCell id="training" value="<b>Single Training Run (Seed 1)</b><br>3600s, 1374 steps, 1x A40<br>Cosine Annealing Schedule" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="50" y="160" width="220" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="final_ckpt" value="<b>Raw Final Checkpoint</b><br>Step 1374 weights<br>Score: 73.622% (±0.00589)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="340" y="80" width="200" height="65" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="ema_ckpt" value="<b>In-Batch EMA Checkpoint</b><br>Decay beta=0.99 (from step 800)<br>Score: 73.552% (±0.00590)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="340" y="240" width="200" height="65" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="soup" value="<b>Intra-Basin Convex Combination</b><br>W_soup = 0.5 * W_final + 0.5 * W_ema<br>Weight Cosine Similarity = 0.9945<br><b>🏆 Score: 73.790% (±0.00587)</b>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#2ca02c;strokeWidth=3;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="610" y="150" width="250" height="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Edges linking soup pipeline --> <mxCell id="e_train_final" value="Step 1374 Weights" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;fontSize=10;" edge="1" parent="1" source="training" target="final_ckpt"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_train_ema" value="EMA Decay (beta=0.99)" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;fontSize=10;" edge="1" parent="1" source="training" target="ema_ckpt"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_final_soup" value="50% Linear Interpolation" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;fontSize=10;" edge="1" parent="1" source="final_ckpt" target="soup"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_ema_soup" value="50% Linear Interpolation" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=classic;fontSize=10;" edge="1" parent="1" source="ema_ckpt" target="soup"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
